$comment: Cross-layer delta L0206-D001 (K1; AI-003 / TOOL-003): ECMAScript own-property enumeration order of tool-argument objects. Scenarios live in conformance/agent/key-order/*.json, discriminated by a top-level `key_order` key. A runner builds `arguments` (an INSERTION SEQUENCE {"$o": [[key, value], ...]}, a key may repeat) by plain assignment in that order, constructs ONE ToolCall with it, and OBSERVES the recursive key enumeration -- never reorders on the pipeline's behalf -- at: `raw` (the constructed ToolCall.arguments, which is also the tools/execution-start payload), `replay` (an AssistantMessage holding the call appended to a fresh session log and replayed), `hook` (the tools/pre-execute listener, before any mutation), `execute`. The tool has `schema` as its parameters ("edit": the built-in edit tool's schema) and, for `prepare: edit`, edit's prepare_arguments. `mutate`: the listener assigns these [key, value] pairs IN PLACE on the arguments object (pinned Pi's beforeToolCall). `replace`: the listener returns this insertion sequence as REPLACEMENT arguments (a Minion mapping; Pi's hook cannot replace). OBSERVATION GRAMMAR: {"o": [[key, observation], ...]} an object in enumeration order; {"a": [...]} an array; a JSON scalar is itself. `provider_text` is the provider argument text pinned Pi decoded (evidence; Minion has no certified raw decoder yet). Expectations: pinned Pi (spec/llm.md, L0206-D001).
